items.title: Eminem’s Publisher Eight Mile Style Sues Suno Over Allegations of Copyright Infringement
items.summary: Eight Mile Style, la editorial de Eminem, presentó una demanda contra Suno alegando que la plataforma reprodujo obras protegidas por derechos de autor sin autorización ni compensación, según la denuncia vista por Digital Music News.

items.title: Elvis Presley Enterprises Slaps Suno With Copyright & NIL Suit, Says the Platform Was ‘Always Meant to Replace the Artists Whose Works and Identities Were Being Unlawfully Copied’
items.summary: Elvis Presley Enterprises, junto a Raleigh Music Publishing y una filial de Authentic Brands Group, presentó una demanda contra Suno por presunta infracción de derechos de autor y de nombre, imagen y semejanza del artista, alegando que la plataforma buscaba reemplazar obras copiadas ilegalmente.

items.title: Suno argues that judge should throw out musician’s publicity rights lawsuit
items.summary: Suno is fighting several music industry lawsuits, but one stands out - filed by musician Jason Isbell - because it accuses the AI company of infringing publicity rights by connecting artist names to musical styles in the back-end. Suno has responded to that lawsuit, urging the judge to dismiss it

Robbie Williams speaks out on ‘disgusting’ plagiarism lawsuits
items.summary: If you’ve heard Olivia Rodrigo’s ‘take me home (4 christmas)’ single, you may have noticed some similarities to Robbie Williams’ 2012 hit ‘Candy’. Is he going to demand a credit, royalties or even sue her? Nope. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Music industry intervenes in Open AI’s big legal battle with newspapers and authors
items.summary: All of the US music industry’s copyright lawsuits against AI companies swing on whether or not AI training is fair use under US law. A big legal battle involving authors, newspapers and Open AI also centres on fair use, and the music industry has now intervened in that case via an amicus brief

tip.title: Documenta tu aporte humano cuando uses IA
tip.body: Las oficinas de derechos de autor protegen la parte creada por una persona. Guarda prompts, versiones, ediciones y decisiones de mezcla: eso es lo que sostiene tu autoría sobre el resultado.

tip.title: Document your human contribution when using AI
tip.body: Copyright offices protect the human-created portion. Keep prompts, versions, edits and mix decisions —that record is what supports your authorship over the final result.
